decision: HARNESS APPROVED for the bounded owned/virtual gate; root READY and exclusive-slot handoff required before launch
resolved_draft_findings: Both owned capture-pattern probes are created and their actual PIDs/child bounds placed in the profile before GUI launch. MCP, Script and geometry calls now match the inspected existing helpers.

Explicit omitted-scope request excludes the field instead of serializing null; selected/partial-all/capture-off/selected-PID denials use actual current permission boundaries and preserve ink/revision and absent or sentinel destination.
Sentinel is a named sentinel_path argument; atomic writer temporary glob matches .mux-export.*.tmp.
GUI completion reads the existing acknowledged annotation journal by exact path and checks authoritative current pending None, avoiding ephemeral export metadata overwritten by telemetry.
Policy equality compares selected users, allowed PIDs, capture and session_control, excluding legitimate reconnect client-list changes.

Two delay-clear operations use distinct current-delay keys. Threaded preparation completion is asserted false after the exact B F5 native down/up recipient witness, then awaited before output decoding.

Matching result annotation.export supplies exact requested scope/revision/composition HWND/PID/dimensions. PNG checks use actual child capture geometry and a background sample outside the white orientation mark.
Relevant ctypes handle/message/geometry APIs are typed; retained handle closure uses a typed CloseHandle.
Initial cursor overlay observation requires two distinct nonzero live HWNDs; observed annotation and magnifier HWNDs are retained for closure checks.

Every imperative attempt is recorded before dispatch. Failure is preserved without automatic replay; final cleanup checks owned parents, exact two copied run-image CIM scope, known overlays, GUI descriptor and private startup key. A survivor remains a failure for identity-bound parent cleanup instead of blind termination.

finite_scope.owned_targets: Two disposable x64 capture-pattern probes, exact PIDs, child HWND ownership and process identity checks; x86 image copied/built, not run.
finite_scope.native_cases: Two-user ink; connected capture/scope/PID denials; selected-user transparent PNG; all-user selected-target composition with B native continuity; pending job revocation/capacity denial; one magnifier PNG regression; normal Stop/close.
finite_scope.local_cases: Actual Draw export omitted-default all-users and selected-user controls, two decoded PNGs and representative 540x520 / 420x520 owned GUI originals.
finite_scope.planned_actions_by_static_read: Nine connected annotation export attempts, fourteen routing_input mutations, one magnifier export, and two GUI annotation exports; read-only inventory/inspect and explicit policy/navigation actions are separate.

limits: No apps, native routing, tests, Cargo or helper execution was performed in this review; only source/AST/hash checks.
This approval is launch readiness, not native, file, timing or pixel acceptance. Raw failures must be retained and material issues stop the gate.

420x520 is a representative compact Draw observation, not the absolute 320x360 minimum. Periodic PNG mtime/geometry is not request-associated freshness; exact originals require independent manual review after cleanup.
Existing provider delay is a bounded owned-fixture observation, not a claim about arbitrary blocked providers, network I/O, all races, or postapproval Stop/crash guarantees.
No hardware, RustDesk, SendInput, OS pointer/foreground manipulation, global/desktop pixel capture, arbitrary unowned process input, x86 execution or full P1/UX/Ultra parity claim.
